scope: First 20 nonempty available posts ordered by posted_at, comment_id
corrections: Used a focused Databricks AI header review to exclude background company offices from an onsite hiring location.
Normalized explicit management titles in hiring headers to leadership.
Left compensation type unspecified when a cash range does not explicitly say base salary.
limitations: Development smoke test refined against the same 20 source posts. Skill checks cover representative explicitly named technologies, not exhaustive precision/recall. This is not held-out or corpus-wide accuracy validation. No full-corpus extraction was launched.
